personas.label: Founder
personas.blurb: I'm building a product and need launch and feature videos.
personas.pacing: Medium: a new shot every 2–3 s; hold the proof shot longer so it can be read.
personas.hook: The customer's pain in their own words (from the validation), then real proof on screen.
personas.tone: Credible and specific: real numbers, real screens, no hype words.
personas.caption_note: Short lines (about 6 words) low in the frame, so the product stays visible.
personas.sound: A calm bed or none; the film must work muted.
personas.ending: Product name and URL for 2 s.

personas.label: Content creator
personas.blurb: I post short videos for my audience on Reels, Shorts and TikTok.
personas.pacing: Fast: a cut every 1–1.5 s, on the beat; no shot sits still for more than 2 s.
personas.hook: A pattern break in the first second: a surprising line, a bold claim they can back, or 'you' talk.
personas.tone: Personal and energetic; spoken, first person, like talking to one viewer.
personas.caption_note: Big, word-by-word captions in the centre safe area, 2–3 words at a time.
personas.sound: Music with a clear beat; cuts land on beats, the big moment on a downbeat.
personas.ending: A loop back to the first frame, or a one-line ask (follow, comment).

personas.label: Indie hacker / developer
personas.blurb: I ship tools and side projects and share them with other builders.
personas.pacing: Medium-fast: show, don't tell; one idea per shot, 1.5–2.5 s each.
personas.hook: It working in frame one: the terminal command or the product doing the thing.
personas.tone: Dry and honest, builder to builder; numbers only if they are true (stars, users, ms).
personas.caption_note: Few words (about 3) as titles over the screen; code stays readable.
personas.sound: Light: typing and UI sounds, a soft bed or silence.
personas.ending: Repo or site URL, plus the install command if there is one.

personas.label: Agency / marketer
personas.blurb: I make marketing videos for clients or for the brand I work for.
personas.pacing: Fast and polished: a cut every 1–2 s, exact timing, nothing left loose.
personas.hook: The client's benefit in 3 words, on brand from the first frame.
personas.tone: Polished and on brand: the client's colours, fonts and words, never ours.
personas.caption_note: Short title captions (about 3 words) in the brand font; one cut per platform ratio.
personas.sound: A licensed track cut to length; logo on the last downbeat.
personas.ending: Logo and one call to action; the same ending on every ratio.

personas.label: Educator / coach
personas.blurb: I teach: courses, tutorials, coaching, tips.
personas.pacing: Calm: 3–4 s per shot so every step can be read; one idea per scene.
personas.hook: A question the viewer has, or 'the mistake most people make'.
personas.tone: Clear and patient; plain words, numbered steps, one example.
personas.caption_note: Full sentences (about 6–7 words a line) so the lesson works muted.
personas.sound: Voiceover first; a quiet bed under it.
personas.ending: What to do next (try it, the course link) in one line.
